title: tests/integration/prm-09-pack-update.test.zig uses unqualified solution_pack_installs — sqlstate 42703 (INC-001 from WF03-GH785-20260815 step-5)

incidental_of.context: Pre-existing test-code bug surfaced during TEST-RUNNER retry 6's optional targeted test runs on the GH-785 verification branch. NOT a GH-785 regression; out of scope for WF03-GH785-20260815.

scope: tests/integration/prm-09-pack-update.test.zig AND production src/definition/pack_update.zig — both referenced `solution_pack_installs` / `solution_pack_artefact_bases` without the `public.` schema prefix; unresolved against the per-tenant search_path the name lands on tenant_default.solution_pack_installs (migration 1158, SOL-02, `-- scope: tenant_only`) with a different column layout, raising sqlstate 42703 on a fresh-migration DB. Migration 1157 (the intended public tables) is PUBLIC-scoped (`-- scope: public.`); the tenant_default shadow is 1158, not 1157.
affected_areas: src/definition/pack_update.zig (PRODUCTION — SUT Step 1 Vb load / Step 2 base load)
description: All four TC-PRM-09-NN tests fail with sqlstate 42703 because the test file AND the production SUT (`src/definition/pack_update.zig`) issue INSERT/SELECT against unqualified `solution_pack_installs` / `solution_pack_artefact_bases`. After the WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815 migration chain, the unqualified name resolves against the per-tenant search_path and lands on `tenant_default.solution_pack_installs` (introduced by migration 1158 with the `-- scope: tenant_only` header), which has a column layout that does not match the PRM-09 parameter list. `public.solution_pack_installs` / `public.solution_pack_artefact_bases` (introduced by migration 1157 with `-- scope: public.` — PUBLIC-scoped, not tenant_only; the tenant_default shadow is 1158) are the actually-intended destination — but the per-tenant search_path wins. The SUT would also 42703 on a fresh DB (the shadow's different column layout) because it relied on search_path fallback too. Pre-existing, NOT a GH-785 regression; out of scope for WF03-GH785-20260815. Picked up by its own WF-03 cycle (GH-792).
symptom: zig build test-integration-prm-09 against BPM_TEST_DB_URL: 4/4 FAIL with `[42703] column X does not exist` against `tenant_default.solution_pack_installs`.
investigation_notes: GH-785 verification confirmed the PLC suite (27/27) is green — the failure surfaces only in the optional targeted PRM-09 run that TEST-RUNNER performed after passing the PLC suite. Direct psql reproduction confirms that `INSERT INTO solution_pack_installs` from a `SET search_path = tenant_default, public` session fails because the tenant-side table has different columns from the public-side table. The test was written against the public-side table. The fix is to qualify every reference to `solution_pack_installs` / `solution_pack_artefact_bases` with `public.`. NOTE (scope correction flagged by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR): this DOES require a production-code change — `src/definition/pack_update.zig` (the SUT) also issues unqualified SELECTs against the two public tables (Step 1 Vb load, Step 2 base load) that would sqlstate 42703 on a fresh DB because the tenant_default shadow (1158) has a different column layout; the earlier record's claims of 'no production-code change required' and that migration 1157 is tenant_only were both wrong.
reproduction: BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test zig build test-integration-prm-09 -> 4/4 FAIL. Reading tests/reports/report-2026-08-15-WF03-GH785-20260815-step05-verify.yaml section INC-001 confirms the same root cause.
fix_line: test file L98/L119/L128/L164 (public. qualifiers); production src/definition/pack_update.zig L120 (Step 1 Vb load) / L182 (Step 2 base load); doc comment L102-107 updated. process_definitions left unqualified (test L145/L160, SUT L238).
fix_diff: Applied: every DML/SELECT reference to `solution_pack_installs` / `solution_pack_artefact_bases` in BOTH files now carries the `public.` prefix (test L98/L119/L128/L164; production pack_update.zig L120/L182), and the pack_update.zig doc comment now states explicit public. qualification. `process_definitions` references are unchanged and remain unqualified (tenant-side). The static qualification check is the authoritative proof because the warm :5453 DB carries the legacy 1157-layout shadow and masks the runtime 42703.

actions: When a test fixture OR the production SUT issues DML/SELECT against a public-scoped table (migration header `-- scope: public.`), it must reference the table with the explicit `public.` schema prefix rather than relying on search_path fallback — under the pool's SCHEMA-mode routing the search path is tenant_default-first, so an unqualified name silently resolves to a same-named tenant-side table with a different column layout (sqlstate 42703 on a fresh DB).

Tenant-side tables (e.g. process_definitions) stay unqualified — they are reached exactly through the per-tenant search path; qualifying them with public. would route reads to a non-existent relation.

When a public-scoped migration (e.g. 1157) shares a table name with a tenant_only migration (e.g. 1158), verify every consumer in both tests/ and src/ that reads the public table is explicitly public.-qualified — check src/ call sites, not just the test file (the SUT itself was broken here).

Prefer the static qualification check (grep every DML/SELECT reference for the public. prefix) as the authoritative proof when the warm DB masks the runtime 42703; a warm-DB test pass alone does not prove the fix.
